# CommandPalette

Ctrl/⌘+K search over pages and actions: grouped, fuzzy-ish filtering (accents ignored, prefix first), ↑↓ Enter, shortcut hints.

`KenosUI.CommandPalette` · Overlays

## Use

```jsx
<KenosUI.CommandPalette items={…} />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="KenosUI.CommandPalette" items="{{…}}"></x-import>
```
